text: Dissociation, including depersonalization, derealization, dissociative identity disorder or dissociation in the context of functional neurological disorder, is classically associated with trauma-related disorders but is increasingly reported in anxiety and depressive disorders. Despite growing evidence linking dissociation to affective symptom severity, functional impairment, and treatment outcomes, its role in anxiety and depression remains insufficiently synthesized.
source_label: Co-occurrence of dissociation and anxiety and depressive disorders in adults: a scoping review
